name: Expose for GNOME
description:
Spreads out the windows of the focused application so you can pick one: only that app's windows, from all workspaces, with minimized windows shown as cards. Toggle it with a keyboard shortcut (default Ctrl+Super+Down) or over D-Bus.

Optional companion app (mouse/keyboard button mapper, CLI): https://github.com/likewise4482/Expose-for-gnome
